kjv: whose belly thou (Yahweh) fillest with thy hid [treasure]
mine: You (Yahweh) fill their womb with treasure
note: utsefunkha "your stored-up things" may be God's provisions for the wicked or his stored-up punishment for them (cf. Job 21:19); the line is obscure and the KJV and I read it similarly, but the KJV's "men [which are] thy hand" reverses "from men by your hand".
